en: <CLT=cltMIND>What exactly did I witness here...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I know for certain that the Exisals are
being controlled by Kokichi's remote control...
<CLT=cltMIND>But why were they focusing on Monokuma?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why would there be an
Electrohammer here?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's out of power.
It must have been used.
<CLT=cltMIND>But used for what...?

But, be careful. The Electrohammer runs
out of battery pretty quickly.

So if you use it against an Exisal, it'll run
out of juice with just one shot, got it?

If the Electrohammer's power is expended,
it requires 24 hours to recharge...
<CLT=cltMIND>We know that for certain...

<CLT=cltMIND>So the Exisals were being controlled
by Kokichi's remote control...
<CLT=cltMIND>but they were focusing on Monokuma?

<CLT=cltMIND>But I don't understand why Monokuma
would tell me any of this.

<CLT=cltMIND>But someone else had this information,
and they kept it to themselves.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's what Monokuma said...

<CLT=cltMIND>Someone other than me knows,
and they're not telling.

<CLT=cltMIND>Could that person...be involved
in this case?
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the bathroom window.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the hangar's only window,
and it's not possible to fit through.

<CLT=cltMIND>That means the only way to get
into this hangar is through the shutter.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the control panel that controls
the electric barrier protecting the hangar.

<CLT=cltMIND>We hit it with an Electrohammer,
so it isn't operational right now.

That's right...
What are these marks here?

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks as if it's been struck by
something sharp. What could these be?

Ah, wait...how were they even able
to damage this in the first place?

In order to get close to this control panel,
you have to turn off the alarm system...
<CLT=cltMIND>

<CLT=cltMIND>So how did the person who
did this get near the control panel?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
I don't have time for it right now...
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a sensor alarm here.

<CLT=cltMIND>You have to use the alarm remote to disable
it to get near the shutter.

<CLT=cltMIND>If you come near the shutter
without the remote...

<CLT=cltMIND>A loud alarm would go off
around the entire academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>We had to use an Electrobomb
to disable the sensor and the alarm.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's how we got into the hangar.

<CLT=cltMIND>Now that I think about it...
there were three Electrobombs total.

<CLT=cltMIND>One was stolen by Maki,
but what of the other two?
